purpose: XChaCha20-Poly1305 (IETF) deterministic encryption round-trip and tamper rejection
note: aad in this vector is the source document's test AAD, not a crypto-envelope/v1 canonical AAD; contract-context binding is exercised by wrap vectors (gap G-03)
assertions: encrypting plaintext with key, nonce, and aad reproduces ciphertextTag exactly (AEAD output is ciphertext || tag, final 16 bytes are the tag)
decrypting ciphertextTag with key, nonce, and aad returns plaintext
authentication is verified before any plaintext is returned

provenance.source: draft-irtf-cfrg-xchacha-03 (XChaCha: eXtended-nonce ChaCha stream cipher), Appendix A.1, published at ietf.org; AEAD_XCHACHA20_POLY1305 is the IETF construction named by the contract for AEAD and wrapping
provenance.generationProcedure: positive values transcribed programmatically from the Appendix A.1 hex dumps (key, IV, AAD, plaintext, ciphertext, tag); negative inputs derive from the positive vector by the declared single-byte tamper rule (xor-0x01-at-offset) or nonce truncation to 23 bytes; reject expectations are definitional AEAD security properties, not invented outputs
